title: New Bern Fire and Rescue Prepare for Hurricane Dorian
description: Dennis Tyndall with New Bern Fire and Rescue explains how first responders and local emergency management prepare ahead of Hurricane Dorian. NCNG service members, N.C. Emergency Management and state partner agencies work as a cohesive unit to prepare for, respond to and recover from the effects of Hurricane Dorian.
keywords: NCNG, N.C. National Guard, Citizen-Soldiers, N.C. Department of Public Safety, 19DoDHurricane, Hurricane Dorian, National Guard, Emergency Management

transcript.text: - Our job for hurricane operations
is to provide fire protection to the citizens,
to evacuate the citizens, provide rescue
and medical attention to the citizens of New Bern.
We really started Sunday with making sure that the equipment
that we had in storage is up
and running, operational correctly.
From there, Monday, we started having meetings
with command staff here in New Bern.
Our department heads for the city of New Bern
started meeting to kind of analyze what the storm was doing,
what the predictions were.
From there we made sure that any equipment or resources
that we needed,
around Tuesday we started calling the county and the state,
requesting those resources.
We started to develop our action plans
and a lot of meetings,
a lot of planning went into this.
For the safety of our citizens,
we started reminding them of the dangers of hurricanes.
We started that a couple days ago.
We started going to our low-lying areas,
our flood-prone areas,
and reminding them that they would need to evacuate.
From there we have...
We've actually set up barricades in those flood-prone areas
so that crew traffic would not
be going through, getting stalled.
We did a code red alert for citizens of New Bern,
and we also, starting this morning,
we had buses going through areas to assist people
getting out of their homes in those low-lying areas.
